product.olivetti-pcs-p-133-n.summary: The 133 MHz PCS on this platform in the Slim Tin Box case.
product.olivetti-pcs-p-133-n.history: Olivetti documented this variant in its Pentium PCS range, which shared a platform with the M4 Modulo of the same generation. The guide identifies TriGem as the maker of the BA2199 board.
product.olivetti-pcs-p-133-n.architectur: The case sets the expansion capacity. The Slim Tin Box riser offers 1 full-length ISA, one PCI and one shared slot.
product.olivetti-pcs-p-133-n.verified: The configuration was checked against the cited sources. BluMach validation is pending.
product.olivetti-pcs-p-133-n.limitations: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
product.olivetti-pcs-p-133-n.service-gui: Olivetti, Personal Computer – Pocket Service Guide, vol. II, ch. 12
product.olivetti-pcs-p-133-n.firmware: The revision helps identify the service BIOS. The guide lists 1.13.
